description: NaBi₅O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.99 Å. There are five inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.36 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.62 Å. In the third Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.79 Å. In the fourth Bi site, Bi is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.37 Å. In the fifth Bi site, Bi is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.40 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Bi atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaBi₃ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Bi atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaBi₃ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Bi atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Bi₂ tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Bi atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and three Bi atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Bi atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four Bi atoms.
